cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?

mechanism: A asks approval for guests already invited by correcting B proposed service arrangements as the only capable host, with patience strained by consent questions.
confusable: Ordinary efficient hosting lacks the completed unapproved invitation and request to ratify it afterward.
comparison: Garden alternative concerns irreversible physical alteration; dinner scene concerns accepted invitations and seating capacity.
seedUse: Dinner seed supplies two chairs/six invitees; S03 should correct an actual service mistake while keeping exact headcount and completed invitation clear.
